definitions.gloss: densely populated area; crowded district; concentrated zone
definitions.explanation: An area where buildings, people, or things are packed closely together. Often used in urban planning, disaster prevention, and geography contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧{密集地|みっしゅうち}だ。
examples.english: This is a densely packed residential area.

examples.japanese: {密集地|みっしゅうち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{火災|かさい}→火災：02561_kasai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がり→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧やすい。
examples.english: Fires spread easily in densely built areas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下町|したまち}→下町：04193_shitamachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{木造|もくぞう}→木造：08328_mokuzou⟧⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{密集地|みっしゅうち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{防災|ぼうさい}→防災：07907_bousai⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: In the old downtown areas of Tokyo, there are many zones with densely packed wooden houses, and disaster prevention is an ongoing challenge.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{密集|みっしゅう}→密集：12342_misshuu⟧ (dense gathering, clustering) + {地|ち} (place, area). Frequently appears in news and policy discussions about urban planning, fire safety, and earthquake preparedness, especially regarding older neighborhoods with narrow streets and wooden buildings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧{密集地|みっしゅうち}: densely packed residential area
- ⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧{密集地|みっしゅうち}: densely populated area
- {密集地|みっしゅうち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{防災|ぼうさい}→防災：07907_bousai⟧: disaster prevention in dense areas
- {密集地|みっしゅうち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧: to avoid crowded areas

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {密集地帯|みっしゅうちたい}: dense zone — near-synonym; ⟦{地帯|ちたい}→地帯：04057_chitai⟧ implies a broader belt or zone
- {過密地域|かみつちいき}: overcrowded region — emphasizes that the density has exceeded a desirable level
- ⟦{市街地|しがいち}→市街地：17083_shigaichi⟧: urban area — describes any built-up area, not necessarily densely packed
